name: Checklist
descriptor: A list where each row is either done or not, with a bar that says how far along you are. Packing, grocery, chores, a clinic opening routine.
verify_checks: progress: a progressOf function is emitted
pros: the bar answers 'am I nearly there' without counting
one tap per row, no form, so it is usable while packing
it survives a reload, which a paper list does not
grouping by category is one select field away
cons: one level: no sub-items, so a nested checklist needs a second app
no assignee, so a shared list is out of scope
no reminders, so it only helps once you open it
reordering by hand is not available; sort is by field
best_for: a finite set of things that each end up done
avoid_if: items have sub-items, quantities to reconcile, or owners
